name: markedit-pdf-export-pretty
description: MarkEdit extension: export the current Markdown document as a nicely rendered PDF

scripts.install-script: npm run build && cp dist/markedit-pdf-export-pretty.js "$HOME/Library/Containers/app.cyan.markedit/Data/Documents/scripts/markedit-pdf-export-pretty.js" && echo 'Installed. Restart MarkEdit.'
scripts.smoke: esbuild test/smoke-entry.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:jsdom --external:markdown-it --external:highlight.js --external:markdown-it-footnote --external:markdown-it-task-lists --external:markdown-it-deflist --external:markdown-it-mark --external:markdown-it-sub --external:markdown-it-sup --outfile=test/.smoke.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node test/.smoke.mjs && rm -f test/.smoke.mjs
